content: We need to determine number of CH3 groups in the compound. But we have no description of the compound. Possibly we need to retrieve NMR spectra to infer? But we don't know the molecule. Maybe the system expects we ask for carbon NMR or proton NMR to count methyl signals. However we have no SMILES. The tools carbon_nmr_spectra, proton_nmr_spectra don't require input? They take no parameters. They presumably operate on "sample at hand". So there is a sample loaded. We can get proton NMR to see number of methyl peaks. Let's call proton_nmr_spectra.
